animations.name: Aquarium
animations.description: A living reef ecosystem rendered in ASCII art. The simulated fish school rests at night, flees a roaming predator, and swarms feeding events, all under a dynamic day and night lighting cycle complete with sunbeams, drifting plankton, swaying kelp, and scurrying sand crabs.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Attractor
animations.description: A mesmerizing visualization of a particle tracing a real strange-attractor equation. It features Lorenz butterfly and Rössler ribbon patterns rendered as speed-weighted ASCII glyphs, viewed through a slowly rotating 3D camera to create a deep sense of mathematical complexity.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Aurora
animations.description: Procedural aurora borealis ribbons dancing gracefully across a twinkling star field. The simulation uses noise functions to create organic, shifting curtains of light that mimic the natural phenomena of the northern lights in a purely text-based format.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Black Hole
animations.description: A stunning depiction of a black hole's accretion disk and event horizon. The animation includes a customizable jet toggle, adjustable disk size, and inclination controls, allowing you to view the gravitational lensing effects from various angles and intensities.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Murmuration
animations.description: Starlings over a meadow through a full day: groups settle on the telegraph wire and ripple off it, a falcon stoops on the flock and panic runs through it in waves, and at dusk the flock swells into a murmuration over the wood before streaming down to roost. A heron crosses by day; bats and fireflies come out at night.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Bonsai
animations.description: A peaceful procedural tree growth simulation that brings digital nature to your terminal. It features customizable leaf density and rest times between redraws, letting you watch a unique bonsai tree slowly take shape, flourish, and then clear to begin anew.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Campfire
animations.description: A cozy, layered noise-driven simulation of flame tongues crackling in the dark. It comes complete with rising embers, a subtle dark forest silhouette in the background, and a drifting firefly that occasionally wanders through the warm glow of the fire.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Crawl
animations.description: An epic retro title crawl inspired by classic sci-fi cinema. You can select your favorite episode text, adjust the scrolling speed, and watch as the golden characters slowly drift into the vanishing point of a starry cosmos.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Crystals
animations.description: A geological cave growth simulation featuring procedural stalactites and stalagmites. Watch as the crystal formations slowly grow over time, illuminating a glowing bioluminescent pool that shimmers gently at the bottom of the cavern.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Cyber Deck
animations.description: A nostalgic and fictional 1998 hacker terminal that never quite finishes booting. It endlessly loops through a chaotic sequence of boot screens, hex dumps, hardware diagrams, digital glitches, and the occasional dramatic kernel panic.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: DNA Helix
animations.description: A 3D ASCII double helix: colour-coded A-T and G-C base pairs twist in perspective as the strand scrolls and sways, with free nucleotides drifting behind it. Every so often a replication fork travels down the helix, unzipping it and zipping it back together.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

params.label: Zoom Level
params.description: How close the camera sits to the helix.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used to draw the base pairs.

animations.name: Fireworks
animations.description: Rockets climb over an ASCII city skyline and burst into peonies, rings, willows, crossettes, hearts and chrysanthemums, lighting up the sky and the windows below. Sparks start white-hot and cool to colour, and every so often a finale salvo fills the sky.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

params.label: Frequency
params.description: How often a new firework launches.

params.label: Particle Count
params.description: How many particles each explosion scatters.

params.label: Gravity
params.description: How quickly falling particles accelerate downward.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used for the explosions.

animations.name: Fluid
animations.description: A real-time fluid dynamics simulation with interactive dye injection. Rendered entirely in ASCII, the solver computes velocity and pressure fields to create incredibly smooth and realistic swirling vortices across your terminal.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Spiral Galaxy
animations.description: A spiral galaxy rendered as an ASCII density map: thousands of stars in logarithmic arms around a glowing core, with bright star-forming knots, a slowly nodding 3D tilt, a twinkling background field and the occasional shooting star.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

params.label: Arm Count
params.description: How many spiral arms the galaxy has.

params.label: Star Density
params.description: How many stars are drawn along each arm.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used for the stars and core.

animations.name: Game of Life
animations.description: Conway's Game of Life reimagined as a digital garden. Cellular automata rules are applied to render the grid as growing and wilting botanical glyphs, turning the classic mathematical simulation into a beautiful, organic time-lapse.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Glitch Field
animations.description: A broken digital reality simulation perfect for cyberpunk aesthetics. It features a character grid torn apart by drifting corruption bands, RGB color splitting, simulated scanline tearing, and visual packet loss.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Incense
animations.description: A relaxing smoke particle simulation rising from a burning incense stick. It features fully adjustable wind and turbulence controls, allowing the wispy ASCII smoke to gently curl and dissipate into the surrounding digital air.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Jellyfish Drift
animations.description: A serene underwater scene of a bioluminescent jellyfish drifting through deep-sea darkness. It features a softly pulsing bell glow, wavy trailing tentacles that respond to fluid physics, and a subtle plankton sparkle in the background.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Mandelbrot
animations.description: A deeply zooming ASCII fractal explorer. The simulation automatically navigates the Mandelbrot set, intelligently jumping between interesting boundary regions and rendering the infinitely complex mathematical shapes in crisp terminal characters.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Matrix
animations.description: A cascading digital rain effect directly inspired by the iconic visuals of The Matrix movie. Streams of glowing green glyphs fall endlessly down the screen, featuring fading trails, random character mutations, and bright leading heads that capture the quintessential cyberpunk aesthetic.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used for the falling characters.

params.label: Density
params.description: How many character columns are active at once.

animations.name: Moon
animations.description: A tranquil orbital ASCII scene featuring a large, cratered moon. The simulation includes a customizable star count, floating space debris, atmospheric glow, and various color palettes to set the perfect nighttime mood.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Nixie
animations.description: A vintage nixie tube clock simulation that brings retro-futuristic timekeeping to your screen. Inspired by joeparadiso/nixie-tube-clock, it features simulated cathode poisoning, rich neon glow bloom, and realistic per-tube electrical flicker.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Ocean Waves
animations.description: An ASCII seascape: rows of waves roll in from the horizon, growing as they near, with whitecaps, a glittering path under the sun or moon, drifting clouds, twinkling stars and the odd passing gull.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

params.label: Wave Speed
params.description: How fast the waves roll across the screen.

params.label: Turbulence
params.description: How choppy and irregular the water looks.

params.label: Palette
params.description: Color scheme used for the water.

animations.name: Oscilloscope
animations.description: A simulation of a CRT lab instrument left running forever in a forgotten workshop. It renders a glowing phosphor Lissajous trace with adjustable decay, authentic scanlines, and a warm cathode-ray bloom effect.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Pendulum Wave
animations.description: A physics simulation of uncoupled pendulums with progressively shorter periods. Watch as they swing in and out of phase, creating mesmerizing travelling waves that periodically snap back into perfect, satisfying synchronization.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Pipes
animations.description: A classic 3D pipe network generator using Unicode box-drawing characters. The procedural network grows in real-time, twisting and turning in 3D space with customizable palettes, adjustable density, and spawn rate controls.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Planet
animations.description: A dynamic rotating planet sphere suspended in space. The simulation features a visible atmosphere, optional planetary rings, and a glowing polar aurora that shifts as the globe slowly turns on its axis.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Sand Mandala
animations.description: A meditative simulation of a radial sand mandala. The intricate geometric pattern builds grain by grain, holds its complete form for a moment of reflection, and then slowly dissolves back into the void before rebuilding a new unique design.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Spider Web
animations.description: A fascinating ecosystem simulation where a spider builds its web strand by strand. It hunts drifting prey, flees from simulated wasp raids and bird strikes, and diligently repairs any damage—all under a soft, atmospheric moonlight glow.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Terrarium
animations.description: An incredibly complex living ecosystem in a glass jar. Plants grow, seed, and decay; fungi recycle the litter; while snails, a centipede, and an ant colony interact in a closed simulation of water, nutrients, and light across shifting day and night cycles. Nothing goes permanently extinct.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Thunderstorm
animations.description: A dramatic, atmospheric simulation of dynamic rain, striking lightning bolts, and heavy storm clouds. It features multiple color palettes and fully adjustable wind and lightning intensity to let you weather the perfect ASCII storm.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Vinyl Spin
animations.description: A spinning turntable simulation for music lovers. It features a rotating groove sheen, a procedural radial label, a tracking tonearm that slowly advances, and atmospheric lamplit dust motes dancing in the air above the record.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Volcanic Flow
animations.description: A majestic night mountain scene dominated by a glowing crater. Lava flows continuously down a fixed channel, accompanied by sudden eruption sparks and a rising, noise-driven smoke plume against the dark sky.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Waterfall
animations.description: A peaceful cascading waterfall flowing through a mossy rock channel. The simulation includes a turbulent base mist and spray burst, crowned by an optional, faint rainbow arc that appears in the ambient light.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com

animations.name: Wind Chimes
animations.description: A relaxing physical simulation of hanging chime tubes swaying as damped pendulums in a gusty breeze. It features proximity glint flashes and synthesized bell tones to create a fully audiovisual meditative experience.
animations.author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com
